title: Employment Situation (Jun 2027 data) — 08:30 ET into a 3-day weekend, on the session the recommended cash-bond tape shuts at 14:00
source: EST: derived from BLS's own published scheduling rule — the Employment Situation is released on the third Friday following the end of the reference week (the Sun-Sat week containing the 12th). THE RULE WAS RE-IMPLEMENTED AND RE-VALIDATED FROM SCRATCH BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed RESEARCH (2026-09-09) rather than inherited from the proposal: 7 for 7 against the four confirmed jobs-* entries on this calendar (2026-09-04, 2026-10-02, 2026-11-06, 2026-12-04) and the three historical Sunday-July-4 releases (2004-07-02, 2010-07-02, 2021-07-02). For June 2027 the reference week is Sun 2027-06-06 to Sat 2027-06-12, and the third Friday after 06-12 is 2027-07-02. The prefix is EST: and not BLS: because bls.gov 403s this runner: /schedule/news_release/2027_sched.htm, /schedule/news_release/empsit.htm, /schedule/schedule/2027_sched.htm and /bls/news-release/empsit.htm all returned HTTP 403 to curl under a browser user-agent on 2026-09-09, WebFetch returned 404 on the first, and fred.stlouisfed.org (the fallback release-date source) failed to connect at all — every one recorded in this event's probe-ref.blocked. A web search corroborates that BLS has not yet published a 2027 schedule at all. A derived date is not a published one
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed RESEARCH (2026-09-09), superseding proposals/jobs-2027-07-02.from-sifma-bond-early-close-2027-07-02.json, which stays where it is and is now shadowed. THREE STRUCTURAL FACTS ESTABLISHED THIS SESSION, none of them in the proposal. (1) IT IS THE LAST PAYROLL BEFORE THE 2027-07-28 FOMC: the same 7-for-7 rule puts the July 2027 Employment Situation on 2027-08-06, nine days AFTER that meeting, so no payroll prints between this one and the decision (jobs-2027-08-06 proposed in the same PR). (2) IT IS THE ONLY US LABOR OR INFLATION PRINT ON THE ENTIRE 2027 CALENDAR — 69 macro-print entries dated 2027+ and not one CPI, PPI, JOLTS, ADP or ECI; every US hard-data series this calendar carries stops at 2026-12. Read the empty 07-02 -> 07-28 corridor as a COVERAGE GAP, never as a quiet tape; the June 2027 CPI lands in it in the real world and CPI has no derivable scheduling rule to propose it with. (3) IT LANDS INTO A 3-DAY WEEKEND (holiday observed Mon 2027-07-05, reopen Tue 2027-07-06) on a session where SIFMA recommends a 14:00 ET cash-bond close while NYSE runs full hours -- see sifma-bond-early-close-2027-07-02. MEASURED THIS SESSION on Yahoo split/dividend-adjusted daily bars, 1993-2026: across the 16 payroll Fridays that precede a 3-day weekend, the REOPEN session's median absolute move is materially larger than after an ordinary payroll Friday in the duration and credit complex -- TLT 0.834% vs 0.437% (permutation p=0.009), LQD 0.441% vs 0.215% (p=0.004), AGG 0.251% vs 0.122% (p=0.020), IEF 0.361% vs 0.222% (p=0.039) -- while DIRECTION stays unpredictable (TLT continues the print-day sign 5 of 16, p=0.21). The equity version of the same statistic does NOT survive its September control and is not carried. Impact high matches every other jobs-* entry; symbols [] matches them too. Estimates widen caution and license no entry.
